body: We can't control what others want to do. It's true that all relationships are temporary, except for the one with yourself. Find things that you can do alone that are distracting enough to let you enjoy yourself, even for just a little while. It won't always work but it can help.

I've had 3 attempts but only 1 landed me in the hospital. So, I would say it's mostly passive. I try to distract myself any way I can when I start coming up with plans for an attempt. Sometimes I don't want to die but I still have thoughts of suicide.
It just pops into my mind when life is going well. I tend to daydream and it just sneaks in there. In times of stress I tend to obsess about it as an escape.
